summary: The refactor looks behaviour-preserving; one defensive gap in the new helper.

findings.title: _is_org_admin dereferences a permission object that may be None
findings.body: `BaseView.get_permission_object` is typed `OrganizationGroup | TModel | None`, and `_is_org_admin` calls `.get_root()` on it without a None check. A request whose permission object resolves to None would raise AttributeError in `_is_org_admin` and return a 500 instead of a 403/404.
findings.recommendation: Guard against a None permission object in `_is_org_admin`.
